mapper.select: select id, douyin_video_id, video_url, title, description, author_sec_user_id, author_name, author_url, cover_url, duration_ms, publish_time, matched_keywords, first_seen_at, last_seen_at, created_at, updated_at from ai_douyin_video where douyin_video_id = #{douyinVideoId}
mapper.update: update ai_douyin_video set video_url = #{videoUrl}, title = #{title}, description = #{description}, author_sec_user_id = #{authorSecUserId}, author_name = #{authorName}, author_url = #{authorUrl}, cover_url = #{coverUrl}, duration_ms = #{durationMs}, publish_time = #{publishTime}, matched_keywords = #{matchedKeywords}, last_seen_at = #{lastSeenAt} where id = #{id}
mapper.select:
select video.id, video.douyin_video_id, video.video_url, video.title, video.description, video.author_sec_user_id, video.author_name, video.author_url, video.cover_url, video.duration_ms, video.publish_time, video.matched_keywords, video.first_seen_at, video.last_seen_at, video.created_at, video.updated_at, current_snapshot.like_count, current_snapshot.collected_at as metrics_collected_at, previous_snapshot.like_count as previous_like_count from ai_douyin_video video left join ai_douyin_video_snapshot current_snapshot on current_snapshot.id = ( select snapshot.id from ai_douyin_video_snapshot snapshot where snapshot.video_id = video.id order by snapshot.collect_window desc, snapshot.id desc limit 1 ) left join ai_douyin_video_snapshot previous_snapshot on previous_snapshot.id = ( select snapshot.id from ai_douyin_video_snapshot snapshot where snapshot.video_id = video.id order by snapshot.collect_window desc, snapshot.id desc limit 1 offset 1 )
video.title like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or video.description like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or video.author_name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or cast(video.matched_keywords as char) like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%')
order by video.last_seen_at desc, video.id desc
